moments.author: New York Giants Head Coach John Harbaugh
moments.quote: Jaxson Dart will undergo season‑ending knee surgery; Jameis Winston will start this week.
moments.why: A huge blow for the Giants and fantasy football leagues—young QB Dart out for the season.

moments.author: Oli Marmol
moments.quote: "Quite honestly, I thought it was pretty embarrassing on his end."
moments.why: A fiery manager ejection over a rookie’s hat prompted viral debate among MLB and sports fans.

moments.author: Charles Barkley
moments.quote: "Me and Ernie are a package deal... unless Ernie changes his mind, next year is my last year 100 percent."
moments.why: Iconic sports chemistry ending: Barkley confirms his and Ernie’s final season succeeding Inside the NBA's move to ESPN.

moments.author: The Athletic
moments.quote: 3 touchdowns. 3 Heisman cellys. A @CanesFootball program record. Have yourself a day, Malachi Toney.
moments.why: Fresh off the field: Toney’s Heisman-level performance is lighting up college football timelines.
